runs.summary: Reached the 60-turn bound for one run; the work so far is committed and the next run continues from the task log with a fresh context. The Ticket card is built and passes every probe, but it's only on the review build: not pushed or live yet, because the probe found one gating bug, and T-478 is set to `doing`.

decisions.decision: Go with A Ticket, plus one piece of B: the action button stays disabled until every required step or field on the card is filled. Build it in centre.tsx and centre.module.css for all six kinds (session, decide, connect, approve, human, watch). Keep the day colour on the stub only, put not-ready news on its own line, and put the finish line and action together on the tear-off foot. Keep Coach Rails where they are and keep the rail anchors on card elements. Run check-rail-pins, probe-day-model and the visual probe at 1440, 1024, 768 and 390 for every kind, then a critic pass. Commit to main and deploy live with cloud/scripts/deploy-clean.sh, keeping the review build in step. Leave B, C and D on the rig page. Move to review with cache-busted live links, noting that a different pick from Adi is a CSS swap.
decisions.why: Adi's complaint was too much colour ('sticky note'). A limits colour to a stub and, unlike D, keeps a container for the rail pins and Coach Rails (T-198, T-269). The button lock fixes T-443. Since 2026-10-16 Adi reviews verified work live (centre-frozen-pending-review).
